title: Create: OreDoubling
body:
Raw Ore Doubling ( Proccesing ) Mod

 

 

Production Chain

  • Crushing 1 Raw Ore → 2 Crushed Ore (in Millstone or Crushing Wheels).
  • Washing Crushed Ore is washed and produces:
    • Iron Dust + Redstone
    • Copper Dust + Clay
    • Gold Dust + Quartz
    • Zinc Dust + Gunpowder
  • Smelting
    • In furnace or blast furnace: Metal Dust → 1 Ingot.
    • In Mechanical Mixer with heat (Blaze Burner heated): Metal Dust → 2 Ingots.

       

       


       

       

      What the Mod Adds

      • All types of molten ores (including ores from other mods)
      • Ore Dust for all supported ores
      • Mechanics for pouring and processing ore through Basin + Mechanical Press
      • Full recipes for processing both single ores and ore blocks in the millstone and crushing wheels
